senses.gloss:
फक्क् फक्क्, cl. 1. P. फक्कति, पफक्क,
फक्किष्यति, अफक्कीत्, फक्कितुम्, to
move slowly, go softly, creep, steal along; to have
a preconceived opinion; to behave ill, act wrongly,
act in a low or unjust manner; to swell: Caus.
फक्कयति, -यितुम्, Aor. अपफक्कत्: Desid.
पिफक्किषति: Intens. पाफक्क्यते.

फक्किका, f. a preconceived opinion, previous
statement; a position, assertion or argument to be
proved, thesis to be maintained; logical exposition
or elucidation; a sophism, a trick, illusion, fraud; N.
of a commentary on the Tarka-saṅgraha.
